about: Questions with recorded measurements, usable as `-q NAME`. Outcomes and model matter. Questions that showed no signal on base Laya against their outcome proxy (is_approval, touches_secret; FINDINGS §60) were removed. Bench-backed entries take their question from bench_suites.json and their number from the latest scorecard. Real-label entries cite FINDINGS and name the measured model; outcome proxies are not semantic gold labels. Failed question shapes are what library.lint warns about.

questions.name: is_instruction

question.instructions: Is this an instruction to perform an action, rather than a question?

questions.state: a user turn to an agent, as plain text
questions.measured: AUC 0.65 (0.61 to 0.69) on 2,125 real agent turns, predicting that the agent used tools; base Laya, asked as the no/yes choice (0.68 plain). The private fine-tune scored 0.75

questions.name: work_finished

question.instructions: Does `latest` say the work is finished, shipped or resolved?

questions.measured: AUC 0.70 (0.63 to 0.77) on 200 latest room messages, predicting resolved room status (100 resolved); base Laya, no/yes choice. Room status is an outcome proxy, not a semantic completion label

questions.name: sentiment
questions.measured: accuracy 0.91 (AUC 0.97) on 200 SST-2 review sentences, chance 0.50; base Laya
questions.source: verdict bench, suite sst2-choice, scorecard v0.7.0

questions.name: is_spam
questions.measured: AUC 0.98 on 200 SMS messages; 98% of spam over 0.5; base Laya
questions.source: verdict bench, suite spam-yesno, scorecard v0.7.0

questions.name: prompt_injection
questions.measured: accuracy 0.80 (AUC 0.93) on 200 English prompts; injection recall 0.64, so rank or fit a cut; base Laya
questions.source: verdict bench, suite injection-choice, scorecard v0.9.0
